scope: All60 unique frozen CM pairs, all algorithm-stable dictionary programmes; current frozen stratum and eligible units. No LR/clinical selection. Shared CM and K variants do not imply independent biological evidence.
unit: Equal-library means within inherited reviewed_patient or sample_fallback block, only paired libraries with both original nodes >=20 cells.
test: Partial rank correlation conditional on all8 prespecified covariates; Freedman-Lane permuted rank residuals at block level; pairwise block bootstrap reranks scores; one BH family all finite tests. No automatic collinearity deletion.
limitations: Candidate discovery and tests share sources; sample fallback not reviewed independent patient; foreign/basic expression flags retained; no confirmed LR or mechanism.
numerical_degeneracy: Rank residual norm <=1e-12 times original centered rank norm (floor1) is zero, no effect estimated.
precision_reason: 81 of11716 hypotheses hit the1/2001 floor; minimumBH0.0723. Uniform fixed20000 permutations over identical full family, no outcome-specific selection or stopping. All effects and original2000-bootstrap CIs must agree and are inherited; no new bootstrap.
